agent.name: Emerging Technology Landscape Agent

analytical_question: Can the brand simplify the next print run?
general_et_finding: As of 2026-11-16, GS1 specifies URI syntax; checkout migration remains in progress.
application_finding: Checkout needs a recognized item identifier.
organization_specific_finding: This brand lacks confirmation from its retail partner.

evidence.claim: End-2027 is a capability ambition. A transition may require software or scanner upgrades.
evidence.source_or_reference: S2 GS1 | 2D Barcodes at Retail POS, release 1.1, §1.2 https://ref.gs1.org/guidelines/2d-in-retail/1.1.0/GS1-2DRetailPOS-Guideline-i1.1-r-2025-12-15
evidence.notes: Same issuer as S1; does not independently corroborate adoption.

value_opportunity_implication: A single code could reduce tag space.
recommendation_management_implication: Keep the linear code for now and monitor the transition.
change_monitoring_triggers: Review new 2D barcode announcements next quarter.
